outcome: I-FABP expression and translocation in ileal tissue (in mice)
cohort: The human cohort consisted of 30 neonates diagnosed with necrotizing enterocolitis and 30 healthy neonates as controls.
finding: I-FABP protein/mRNA and IL-6 levels were significantly higher in human neonates with NEC compared to healthy neonates, suggesting their utility as diagnostic biomarkers for NEC.
cross-section timing: Measured at the point of NEC diagnosis for cases and at a healthy state for controls in neonates.
